headline: DMD Advocates advises NDR Auto Components on Joint Venture with South Korea’s DYA

detail: NDR Auto Components Limited is forming a joint venture with DYA Co., Ltd., a South Korean manufacturer of automotive seating systems based in Gwangju and an established seat supplier to Hyundai and Kia in Korea. DMD Advocates advised NDR Auto Components on this JV. The transaction was led by Saiyam Chaturvedi (Partner) and Aishwarya Gupta (Principal Associate), with strategic inputs from Rashi Dhir (Senior Partner & Head of Corporate). Rashi Dhir, Saiyam Chaturvedi NDR and DYA will hold shares in the joint venture company in the ratio of 51:49.
